name: speech_profile
description: Manage the owner's speech profile — the terms, names, phrases and confirmed mishearing corrections that make speech-to-text understand them accurately. Use 'view' to see what's stored, 'add_term' for a word or project name ASR gets wrong, 'add_correction' for a specific mishearing (heard + meant), 'add_example' to store a confirmed transcript for a real clip, 'add_phrase' for a short phrase with correct spelling, 'reset' to clear everything. Only ever store what the owner actually confirms — never invent a term or an example.

action.description: 'view' shows the current speech profile. 'add_term' stores a word/name ASR gets wrong. 'add_correction' stores a heard->meant mishearing pair. 'add_example' stores a confirmed transcript for a real audio clip. 'add_phrase' stores a short phrase with correct spelling. 'reset' clears the whole profile.

term.description: The word, name or project term to store. Required for action='add_term'.

heard.description: What the transcriber heard (the wrong word). Required for action='add_correction'.

meant.description: What was actually said (the correct word). Required for action='add_correction'.

audio_ref.description: Optional reference/URL for the audio clip. Used with action='add_example'.

transcript.description: The owner-confirmed transcript. Required for action='add_example'.

phrase.description: A short phrase with correct spelling. Required for action='add_phrase'.
